paragraphs: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. is a Nevada corporation with our principal executive offices at Two Pennsylvania Plaza, New York, NY 10121. Unless the context otherwise requires, all references to "we," "us," "our," "MSG Sports" or the "Company" refer collectively to Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., a holding company, and its direct and indirect subsidiaries. We conduct substantially all of our business activities discussed in this Annual Report on Form 10-K through MSG Sports, LLC and its direct and indirect subsidiaries.

The Company was originally incorporated in Delaware on March 4, 2015 as an indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary of MSG Networks Inc. ("MSG Networks"). All of the outstanding common stock of the Company was distributed to MSG Networks stockholders (the "MSGS Distribution") on September 30, 2015.

On April 17, 2020, the Company distributed all of the outstanding common stock of Sphere Entertainment Co. (formerly Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. and referred to herein as "Sphere Entertainment") to its stockholders (the "Sphere Distribution").

On July 9, 2021, MSG Networks merged with a subsidiary of Sphere Entertainment and became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sphere Entertainment. Accordingly, agreements between the Company and MSG Networks are now effectively agreements with Sphere Entertainment on a consolidated basis.

On April 20, 2023 (the "MSGE Distribution Date"), Sphere Entertainment distributed approximately 67% of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock of Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (referred to herein as "MSG Entertainment") to its stockholders (the "MSGE Distribution"). All agreements between the Company and MSG Entertainment described herein were between the Company and Sphere Entertainment prior to the MSGE Distribution (except agreements entered into after the MSGE Distribution Date).
On June 10, 2025, the Company completed its conversion from a corporation organized under the laws of the State of Delaware to a corporation organized under the laws of the State of Nevada.
Unless the context otherwise requires, all references to MSG Entertainment, Sphere Entertainment and MSG Networks refer to such entity, together with its direct and indirect subsidiaries.

The Company reports on a fiscal year basis ending on June 30th. In this Annual Report on Form 10-K, the years ended on June 30, 2026, 2025 and 2024 are referred to as "fiscal year 2026", "fiscal year 2025", and "fiscal year 2024", respectively.

On February 18, 2026, the Company's board of directors (the "Board of Directors") authorized management to explore a potential spin-off that would separate the Company's New York Rangers ("Rangers") business from its New York Knickerbockers ("Knicks") business, creating two distinct publicly traded companies. On April 28, 2026, the Company incorporated MSGS Spinco, Inc., a Nevada corporation and direct, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company ("Spinco"), to hold the Rangers business. If the Company proceeds with the spin-off transaction, the spin-off is expected to be structured as a tax-free distribution to all Company stockholders and upon completion of the contemplated separation, it is expected that each record holder of Company Class A common stock would receive one share of Spinco Class A common stock for every two shares of Company Class A common stock held, and each record holder of Company Class B common stock would receive one share of Spinco Class B common stock for every two shares of Company Class B Common Stock held, representing a pro-rata distribution of 100% of the common stock of Spinco. The Company refers to the potential spin-off as the "Rangers Distribution". There can be no assurance that the Rangers Distribution will be completed in the manner described above, or at all. Completion of the Rangers Distribution would be subject to various conditions, including final approval by the Board of Directors, league approval, receipt of a tax opinion and the filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC") and effectiveness of the Form 10 registration statement. The Company will maintain the current operating structure and will continue to report the financial results of its Rangers business in continuing operations until the Rangers Distribution is completed.

The Company owns and operates a portfolio of assets featuring some of the most recognized teams in all of sports, including the Knicks of the National Basketball Association ("NBA") and the Rangers of the National Hockey League ("NHL"). Both the Knicks and the Rangers play their home games in Madison Square Garden Arena ("The Garden"), also known as The World's Most Famous Arena. The Company also includes two development league teams — the Hartford Wolf Pack of the American Hockey League ("AHL") and the Westchester Knicks of the NBA G League ("NBAGL"). Our professional sports franchises are collectively referred to herein as our "sports teams." The Company also operates a professional sports team performance center — the Madison Square Garden Training Center in Greenburgh, NY.
•Iconic sports franchises with renowned global brands;
•Enduring and meaningful presence in the New York metropolitan area, the nation's largest media market;
•Deep connections with large and passionate fan bases that span a wide demographic mix;
•Multi-year sponsorship and suite agreements through a strategic partnership with MSG Entertainment;

paragraphs: The following is a summary of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results. For a more complete discussion of the material risks facing our business, please see below.
•Competition with other sports franchises, leisure-time activities, and other entertainment options may adversely affect our business and results of operations.
•Our business may be adversely affected if the popularity and competitive success of the Knicks and Rangers decline.
•Our decisions concerning player and coach selection or salaries may have a negative impact on our business and results of operations.
•The actions of the NBA and NHL may have a material negative effect on our business and results of operations.
•Injuries and illnesses suffered by our players may adversely affect the success of the business.

paragraphs: This Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations ("MD&A") contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. In this MD&A, there are statements concerning the future operating and future financial performance of Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. and its direct and indirect subsidiaries (collectively, "we," "us," "our," "MSG Sports," or the "Company") including the potential spin-off of the Company's New York Rangers ("Rangers") business (the "Rangers Distribution") through the distribution of the common stock of MSGS Spinco, Inc. ("Spinco"). See Note 1 to the consolidated financial statements included in Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further discussion of the Rangers Distribution. Words such as "expects," "anticipates," "believes," "estimates," "may," "will," "should," "could," "potential," "continue," "intends," "plans," and similar words and terms used in the discussion of future operating and future financial performance identify forward-looking statements. Investors are cautioned that such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance, results or events and involve risks and uncertainties and that actual results or developments may differ materially from the forward-looking statements as a result of various factors. Factors that may cause such differences to occur include, but are not limited to:
•the level of our revenues, which depends in part on the popularity and competitiveness of our sports teams and their ability to reach and advance in the playoffs;
•costs associated with player injuries, waivers or contract terminations of players, coaches and other team personnel;
•changes in professional sports teams' compensation, including the impact of signing free agents and executing trades, subject to league salary floors and caps and the impact of luxury tax;
•general economic conditions, especially in the New York City metropolitan area, including any economic downturn, recession, financial instability, impacts from government shutdowns or inflation;
•the demand for sponsorship arrangements and for advertising; •competition, for example, from other teams and other sports and entertainment options;

•changes in laws, National Basketball Association ("NBA") or National Hockey League ("NHL") rules, regulations, guidelines, bulletins, directives, policies and agreements, including the leagues' respective collective bargaining agreements (each, a "CBA") with their players' associations, salary caps, escrow requirements, revenue sharing, NBA luxury tax thresholds and media rights, or other regulations under which we operate;

•developments affecting the regional sports network industry, including the effects of such developments on MSG Networks Inc.'s ("MSG Networks") solvency and its ability to perform its obligations under its local telecast rights agreements with us;
•a default by our subsidiaries under their respective credit facilities; •any NBA, NHL or other work stoppage;
•any economic, political or other actions, such as boycotts, protests, work stoppages or campaigns by labor organizations;
•geopolitical risks, including the risks of foreign wars and conflicts, including the conflict with Iran and related unrest in the Middle East, on international, domestic and local economies;
•the performance by our affiliates of their obligations under various agreements with the Company;
•seasonal fluctuations and other variation in our operating results and cash flow from period to period;
•the level of our expenses, including our corporate expenses;

paragraphs: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. 為一間內華達州公司，本公司主要營運總部位於紐約州紐約市兩號賓州廣場 10121。除非文意另有明確要求，所有提及「我們」、「我們」、「我們」、「MSG Sports」或「本公司」之參考，均指 Madison Square Garden Sports Corp.，為一間控股公司，及其直接與間接之子公司。我們在本年度報告 10-K 中所討論之幾乎所有營運活動，均透過 MSG Sports, LLC 及其直接與間接之子公司進行。
本公司最初於 2015 年 3 月 4 日在特拉華州註冊成立，為 MSG Networks Inc.（"MSG Networks"）之間接、全資子公司。本公司所有流通普通股於 2015 年 9 月 30 日已發放予 MSG Networks 股東（"MSGS Distribution"）。
2020 年 4 月 17 日，本公司將 Sphere Entertainment Co.（原為 Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp.， herein 稱為 "Sphere Entertainment"）所有流通普通股發放予股東（"Sphere Distribution"）。
2021 年 7 月 9 日，MSG Networks 與 Sphere Entertainment 之子公司合併，成為 Sphere Entertainment 之全資子公司。因此，本公司與 MSG Networks 之間之協議，現已實際上成為與 Sphere Entertainment 之協議，以合併基礎進行。

2023 年 4 月 20 日（"MSGE Distribution Date"），Sphere Entertainment 將 Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp.（ herein 稱為 "MSG Entertainment"）約 67% 流通普通股發放予股東（"MSGE Distribution"）。本公司與 MSG Entertainment 之間之協議， herein 所述，均為本公司與 Sphere Entertainment 之間之協議，於 MSGE Distribution 之前（除 MSGE Distribution Date 之後所簽訂之協議外）。
2025 年 6 月 10 日，本公司完成從特拉華州法規下之公司轉變為內華達州法規下之公司。
除非文意另有明確要求，所有提及 MSG Entertainment、Sphere Entertainment 及 MSG Networks 之參考，均指該實體，連同其直接與間接子公司。
本公司以財務年度為基礎進行報告，財務年度結算日為 6 月 30 日。在本年度報告書（Form 10-K）中，結算日為 2026 年 6 月 30 日、2025 年 6 月 30 日及 2024 年 6 月 30 日之年度，分別稱為 "財務年度 2026"、"財務年度 2025" 及 "財務年度 2024"。

於2026年2月18日，本公司董事會（"董事會"）授權管理階層探討一項潛在分拆交易，將本公司紐約遊騎兵隊（"遊騎兵隊"）業務與紐約尼克隊（"尼克隊"）業務分離，形成兩家獨立上市的公司。於2026年4月28日，本公司設立MSGS Spinco, Inc.，為內華達州公司，並為本公司之直接、 wholly owned subsidiary（"Spinco"），用以持有遊騎兵隊業務。若本公司進行分拆交易，該分拆預期將以無稅務負擔方式發放給所有本公司股東，並在完成預期分離後，預期每持有兩股本公司A類普通股之記錄股東將獲得一股Spinco A類普通股，每持有兩股本公司B類普通股之記錄股東將獲得一股Spinco B類普通股，代表Spinco普通股100%之比例發放。本公司將此潛在分拆稱為"遊騎兵隊分拆"。無法保證遊騎兵隊分拆將如上述方式完成，或是否會完成。遊騎兵隊分拆之完成將受多項條件限制，包括董事會最終批准、聯盟批准、取得稅務意見及向證券交易委員會（"SEC"）提交並使Form 10登記聲明生效。本公司將維持現有營運結構，並在遊騎兵隊分拆完成前，繼續將遊騎兵隊業務之財務結果列為持續營運業務。

本公司擁有並營運一組資產組合，包含體育界最知名的一些球隊，包括國家籃球協會（"NBA"）之尼克隊與國家冰球聯盟（"NHL"）之遊騎兵隊。尼克隊與遊騎兵隊均在其主場 Madison Square Garden Arena（"The Garden"）進行比賽，也稱為"世界上最著名的體育場"。本公司亦包含兩支發展聯盟球隊——美國冰球聯盟（"AHL"）之哈特福德狼羣隊與NBA G League（"NBAGL"）之威斯特徹斯特尼克隊。我們之專業體育俱樂部 collectively 稱為"體育隊"。本公司亦營運一專業體育隊訓練中心——位於紐約格林布什之 Madison Square Garden Training Center。
•具有國際知名品牌的體育俱樂部;
•在紐約都會區，美國最大媒體市場，擁有長久且深具影響力的在地存在;
•與廣泛人口結構之熱情球迷羣有深厚連結;
•透過與MSG娛樂之戰略合作夥伴關係，擁有多年贊助與包廂契約;

paragraphs: 本項管理層討論與分析財務狀況及營運成果（"MD&A"）包含根據1995年私人證券訴訟改革法案所定義之預測性陳述。在本項MD&A中，有關於Madison Square Garden Sports Corp.及其直接與間接子公司（合稱"我們"、"我們"、"我們的"、"MSG Sports"或"本公司"）未來營運與財務表現之陳述，包括本公司New York Rangers（"Rangers"）業務（"Rangers Distribution"）透過發行MSGS Spinco, Inc.（"Spinco"）普通股之分拆（"Rangers Distribution"）。請參閱本年度10-K表報第8項所包含之綜合財務資料附註1，以取得關於Rangers Distribution之進一步討論。詞彙如"預期"、"預期"、"相信"、"估計"、"可能"、"將"、"應該"、"可能"、"潛在"、"持續"、"意圖"、"計畫"及類似詞彙，用於未來營運與財務表現之討論，為預測性陳述。投資人應注意，此類預測性陳述並非未來表現、結果或事件之保證，且涉及風險與不確定性，實際結果或發展可能與預測性陳述有重大差異。導致此類差異發生之因素包括，但不僅限於：
•我們之收入水準，部分取決於我們體育隊伍之受歡迎程度與競爭力及其在季後賽中晉級之能力；
•與球員受傷、放棄合約或球員、教練及其他球隊人員合約終止相關之成本；
•專業體育隊伍薪酬之變動，包括簽約自由球員與執行交易之影響，受聯盟薪資底線與上限限制，以及奢侈稅之影響；
•總體經濟狀況，特別是在紐約市都會區，包括任何經濟衰退、經濟不景氣、財務不穩定、政府停擺之影響或通貨膨脹；
•對贊助協議與廣告之需求；•競爭，例如來自其他球隊及其他體育與娛樂選擇；
•法律、國家籃球協會（"NBA"）或國家冰球聯盟（"NHL"）規則、規範、指引、公告、指示、政策與協議之變動，包括聯盟各自之集體談判協議（每項為"CBA"）與其球員協會、薪資上限、賠款要求、收入共享、NBA奢侈稅門檻與媒體權，或我們運作之其他規範；
•影響區域體育網路產業之發展，包括這些發展對MSG Networks Inc.（"MSG Networks"）償還能力及其履行與我們之地方轉播權協議義務之能力之影響；
•本公司子公司在其各自信用融資安排下違約；•任何NBA、NHL或其他罷工事件；
•任何經濟、政治或其他行動，例如罷工、遊行、罷工或勞工組織的運動；
•地緣政治風險，包括外國戰爭與衝突的風險，包括與伊朗的衝突及中東地區相關的動盪，對國際、國內及地方經濟的影響；
•本公司 affiliates 履行其根據各項協議與本公司所訂立義務的表現；
•我們營運成果與現金流的季節性波動及其他週期性變動；
•我們的費用水平，包括我們的公司費用；

headings: 經濟與商業關係相關風險

本公司面臨激烈且廣泛的競爭，可能對本公司業務及營運結果產生重大負面影響。
本公司有關籃球與冰 Hockey 的決策，特別是與球員及教練選拔及薪資相關的決策，可能對本公司業務及營運結果產生重大負面影響。
NBA 與 NHL 的措施可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生重大負面影響。
本公司運動隊員受傷或患病可能影響本公司成功表現。
本公司業務已受到總體經濟衰退、蕭條、財務不穩定或通貨膨脹等不利影響，未來亦可能產生重大不利影響。
本公司可能需要額外資金以支應持續營運，而資金取得之可能性極為不確定。
紐約市不動產稅豁免政策變更或撤回可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生重大負面影響。
勞動相關事項可能對本公司業務及營運成果產生重大負面影響。
本公司業務依賴於關聯機構之表現，包括各項協議下之財務義務履行情況。
本公司業務受季節性變動影響，營運成果與現金流可能於不同期間產生顯著變動。
本公司可能進行收購及其他戰略交易以補充或擴展業務，但這些交易可能無法成功。
本公司營運及營運結果已受或未來可能受疫情或其他公共衛生緊急事件的重大影響。
本公司業務可能因恐怖攻擊或恐怖攻擊威脅及其他使民眾避免聚集於重要公共集會場所的事件而受到不利影響。
本公司受資料隱私權、資料保護及資料安全規範與法律之約束，若未遵守相關規範與法律，可能面臨重大處罰。
paragraphs: 以下為可能對本公司業務、營運及財務結果產生不利影響的主要風險摘要。如需更完整的重大風險討論，請參閱下文。
•與其他運動俱樂部、休閒活動及其他娛樂選擇的競爭，可能對本公司業務及營運結果產生不利影響。
